Think about important first days in a person’s life. Guess how old your partner
was for each of these firsts. You and your partner have two minutes.
first time he or she traveled alone first time he or she spoke English |

A: Were you 18 the first time you traveled alone?
What was the first day of school like for someone in your family or for a close friend?
Interview the person. Then write about it.
My father was nervous on his first day of school. His father,
my grandfather, took him to school. My father met Charlie
on the first day of school. Charlie became his best friend.
